It is the upgraded form of the {{Item|Soulflow Battery}} and the final form of the {{Item|Soulflow Pile}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Enderman Slayer VII}} |A1 = Null Ovoid, 32 |B1 = Null Ovoid, 32 |C1 = Null Ovoid, 32 |A2 = Null Atom |B2 = Soulflow Battery |C2 = Null Atom |A3 = Null Ovoid, 32 |B3 = Null Ovoid, 32 |C3 = Null Ovoid, 32 |Output = Soulflow Supercell }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Accessory |rarity = epic |item_ability_name = Overflow Mana |item_ability_description = When leaving combat, convert up to {{Stat|4 Soulflow}} into {{Stat|600 Overflow Mana}}.
